name: regression-verification
input_files: file-backed fixture: project-owned regression/catalog.json, checks.json, module manifests, profiles, native test inventory, optional UI/design surface inventory, and optional privacy-safe Codex rework inventory
output_contract: After the final file write, automatically execute the project-declared completion entrypoint and rerun it after any later write; audit the project-owned modular regression center, including UI/design evidence and authorized privacy-safe Codex rework promotion, and report exact PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED, KNOWN_FAIL, or SKIPPED evidence without duplicating native tests.
rollback_boundary: Restore only regression catalog, module, profile, inventory, documentation, or skill-package files changed by the current task; never erase native tests, production data, credentials, or unrelated worktree changes.
